entries.german: Michel von Rosenburg stellt abermals Bescheinigung darüber aus, daß ihm Philipp Graf zu Hanau d. J. Entschädigung für in seinem Dienst zu Grunde gerichtete Pferde gewährt habe.
entries.english: Michael von Rosenberg once again issues a certificate that Philipp Count of Hanau the Younger had compensated him for horses ruined in his service.

facts.content: acknowledged that Philipp von Hanau der Jüngere had compensated him for horses ruined in his service.
